what: Photos are printed with a character ramp (· : / + × # ■). Each cell reads the photo as 2×2 dots and takes the average brightness (dark shapes weight toward the dark share). Cells crossed by thin lines (dark-dot share .4 or more) are kept alive, then a character as dense as the brightness is picked. Above .55 brightness uses the text color, above .22 a faint color, below that a fainter color. Each time it enters the screen, after .15s the cells light up in random order over 1.1s power2.out. Videos and image sequence strips are re-printed as they play

options.look: light (default — shoots a bright place, dark background) | dark (shoots a dark place, light background)
options.cell: Cell size (px), default 6 · 4 when height is under 420
options.fit: Photo height as its share of the cell, default .94
options.min: Cells darker than this (pale for dark type) are left empty, default .03
options.frames: Number of images if it is a continuous photo joined in a horizontal strip, default 1
options.--fx-glyph-ink·dim·faint: Three-level text color (CSS variables), default --kf-ink and 34% · 22% of it toward the background

note: Image reads transparent areas as 0, so cut-out PNGs fit well. Glyph font is --kf-font-glyph (falls back to --kf-font-display)

from.where: index.js eye() · horse() — the dot eye in the About panel (light, 2×2 samples · knee .35) and the running horse in the Footer (dark, threshold .4 · gamma .5, 15 frames at 16fps). Sampling, threshold and reveal values of the original EyeStage · HorseStage
